integrity: The analytic support inequality and two-point extremal constructions establish the infinite-family claim. A standalone exact-rational checker corroborates algebraic and finite sampling identities. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact structural comparison only for one normalized directed four-node network under nonnegative demand realized before deterministic Wardrop adjustment. Not an ex-ante stochastic user equilibrium, generic network theorem, or field-data validation. Historical priority is provisional, particularly for unavailable complete stochastic-equilibrium articles.
title: A sharp mean–variance frontier for demand-uncertain Braess routing
